articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenSSH Flaw Could Let Attackers Bypass Password Authentication on Alpine Linux Servers
articles.summary:

articles.title: HYFLOCK Ransomware Encrypts Only First 4KB of Larger Files, Leaves Parts of Victims’ Files Accessible
articles.summary:
HYFLOCK ransomware has an encryption weakness that leaves parts of larger files readable, giving affected organizations a limited chance to recover data without paying attackers.
